name: Noctowl
flavorText: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

levelUp.name: Sky Attack
levelUp.description: A second-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Tackle
levelUp.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

levelUp.name: Growl
levelUp.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The target’s Attack stat is lowered.

levelUp.name: Foresight
levelUp.description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

levelUp.name: Hypnosis
levelUp.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

levelUp.name: Peck
levelUp.description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

levelUp.name: Uproar
levelUp.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

levelUp.name: Reflect
levelUp.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

levelUp.name: Confusion
levelUp.description: The foe is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the foe confused.

levelUp.name: Hidden Power
levelUp.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

levelUp.name: Take Down
levelUp.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

levelUp.name: Air Slash
levelUp.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Zen Headbutt
levelUp.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Extrasensory
levelUp.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the foe flinch.

levelUp.name: Psycho Shift
levelUp.description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

levelUp.name: Roost
levelUp.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

levelUp.name: Dream Eater
levelUp.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

tmHm.name: Toxic
tmHm.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tmHm.name: Hidden Power
tmHm.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

tmHm.name: Sunny Day
tmHm.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tmHm.name: Hyper Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tmHm.name: Protect
tmHm.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Rain Dance
tmHm.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

tmHm.name: Frustration
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Return
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Psychic
tmHm.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tmHm.name: Shadow Ball
tmHm.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tmHm.name: Double Team
tmHm.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tmHm.name: Reflect
tmHm.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tmHm.name: Aerial Ace
tmHm.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

tmHm.name: Facade
tmHm.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tmHm.name: Secret Power
tmHm.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

tmHm.name: Rest
tmHm.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tmHm.name: Attract
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tmHm.name: Thief
tmHm.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

tmHm.name: Steel Wing
tmHm.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

tmHm.name: Roost
tmHm.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

tmHm.name: Endure
tmHm.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Silver Wind
tmHm.description: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

tmHm.name: Recycle
tmHm.description: The user recycles a single-use item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

tmHm.name: Giga Impact
tmHm.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

tmHm.name: Psych Up
tmHm.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

tmHm.name: Captivate
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

tmHm.name: Sleep Talk
tmHm.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tmHm.name: Natural Gift
tmHm.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

tmHm.name: Dream Eater
tmHm.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

tmHm.name: Swagger
tmHm.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tmHm.name: Pluck
tmHm.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

tmHm.name: Substitute
tmHm.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tmHm.name: Fly
tmHm.description: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

tmHm.name: Defog
tmHm.description: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.

tutor.name: Mud-Slap
tutor.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

tutor.name: Ominous Wind
tutor.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

tutor.name: Air Cutter
tutor.description: The user launches razorlike wind to slash the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tutor.name: Zen Headbutt
tutor.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

tutor.name: Twister
tutor.description: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Heat Wave
tutor.description: The user exhales a heated breath on the foe to attack. It may also leave the target with a burn.

tutor.name: Swift
tutor.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

tutor.name: Uproar
tutor.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.
